description: This file defines interfaces and macros related to MAP (Manifold Absolute Pressure) sensor processing, including prototypes for initializing the map decoder, retrieving raw and processed MAP readings, and converting pressure units.

methods.name: initMapDecoder
methods.description: Initializes the map decoder, accepting a shared logger and engine parameters.

methods.name: getRawMap
methods.description: Returns the current raw MAP sensor value.

methods.name: getBaroPressure
methods.description: Returns the current barometric pressure reading.

methods.name: hasBaroSensor
methods.description: Checks if a barometric sensor is present.

methods.name: hasMapSensor
methods.description: Checks if a MAP sensor is present.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the MAP value averaged over a measurement window.

methods.name: getMapByVoltage
methods.description: Calculates MAP from a voltage reading, using engine parameters.

methods.name: decodePressure
methods.description: Decodes the pressure from a voltage reading, given sensor configuration.
